Elaine (AE): Heads up — VanguardBank pushed the SIG back with a 48h turnaround. They specifically want Q23 (KMS rotation policy), Q31 (network segmentation / peering), and Q58 (third-party subproc evidence). Link to questionnaire: https://drive.example.com/sig/vanguard-2024. Can we collect artifacts?

Omar (Security): I can take KMS key policy + metadata. Maya, can you pull CloudTrail rotation events and sanitized console screenshots? Raj, can you export the VPC diagram + firewall rule snapshot?

Maya (SRE): Yep. I can generate a rotation log extract and screenshots. Need the exact key alias/name and where to drop files (s3 or shared drive). Also will redact any user emails/IDs.

Elaine (AE): Put everything in s3://evidence-share/vanguardbank/SIG-1735554321 and paste links here. Customer wants PDFs for policy docs, and redacted logs for audit. I'll assemble final packet and include a signed cover sheet.

Raj (SE): I have the infra diagrams in infra-repo. I'll export a network diagram (draw.io) and a firewall rules snippet. Note: we use transit-gw for east/west; will include a short writeup explaining segmentation. ETA ~2 hours.

Omar (Security): Quick checklist to ensure completeness: KMS key policy (PDF), key rotation schedule (docs), CloudTrail extracts showing rotation events, IAM role list with ARNs, SOC2 cert (latest), pentest summary (redacted), VPC diagrams, firewall/ACL snapshots, vendor/subproc list. Add a README describing redactions and provenance before handing to sales.

Maya (SRE): I'll run these commands to extract rotation info and scrub before upload:
```
# list keys + rotation status (us-east-1)
aws kms list-keys --region us-east-1
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id alias/redwood-prod

# cloudtrail event lookup for key rotation (adjust dates)
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2024-03-01 --end-time 2024-03-29
```
I'll replace account IDs with <ACCOUNT_ID_REDACTED> and remove user emails.

Elaine (AE): Please also include a short note whether the KMS keys are HSM-backed (customer asked). And confirm backup retention for logs (they asked about 7 years).

Omar (Security): KMS keys are AWS-KMS with AWS-managed CMKs for this tenant; include that in README and attach our KMS key policy PDF. For retention: CloudTrail aggregated to our logs bucket with lifecycle 7y for audit buckets — include retention policy screenshot. I'll do a quick review before upload.

evidence-bot: Reminder: SLA 48h for VanguardBank SIG — ticket SV-5732 created and assigned to sales.

Raj (SE): Uploading network diagram and firewall snippets now. s3://evidence-share/vanguardbank/SIG-1735554321/network/diagram-drawio, s3://evidence-share/vanguardbank/SIG-1735554321/network/firewall-snippet.txt

Maya (SRE): Uploaded KMS rotation extract and sanitized CloudTrail JSON to s3://evidence-share/vanguardbank/SIG-1735554321/kms_rotation.json and s3://evidence-share/vanguardbank/SIG-1735554321/cloudtrail_rotation_redacted.json. README.md with redaction notes included.

Elaine (AE): Perfect. I'll assemble the ZIP for VanguardBank and send over with a short response summarizing each artifact. Thanks all :heart:

Omar (Security): I'll do final sign-off and add a short security statement confirming redactions and that no sensitive PII is included.

Elaine (AE): ETA to customer: later today. Will post final send receipt here.
